handoff: Approve, no blocking findings: fail-fast: false on both shard matrices (repo.test AC5) and ci-failures.sh lists cancelled/skipped jobs as unknown (ci-check.test, real jq filter). Minor: timed_out still left out.

findings.title: Other non-success conclusions (timed_out, startup_failure, action_required) are still left out
findings.detail:
The filter allow-lists failure, cancelled and skipped. A job whose conclusion is timed_out or startup_failure would be left out of the rework brief as if it had passed. Checked: jq with the script's filter on a job with conclusion timed_out prints nothing for it. The spec names only cancelled and skipped, so this does not block.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: A later change could select every conclusion other than success (and neutral), so any job that did not pass is listed.
